milestones.title: NumPy Arrays
milestones.description: Vectorised operations, indexing, broadcasting and why arrays are faster than lists for numeric work.

milestones.title: pandas DataFrames

resources: Python for Data Analysis by Wes McKinney

milestones.title: Data Cleaning
milestones.description: Missing values, duplicates, type conversion and tidy-data principles on a messy real dataset.
